booking_events_job_update_has_content.name: booking_events_job_update_has_content
booking_events_job_update_has_content.value: "booking_events"."kind"::text <> 'job-update' or "booking_events"."job_status" is not null or "booking_events"."note" is not null or "booking_events"."had_photos"

booking_events_booked_is_plain.name: booking_events_booked_is_plain
booking_events_booked_is_plain.value: "booking_events"."kind"::text <> 'booked' or ("booking_events"."job_status" is null and "booking_events"."note" is null and "booking_events"."photo_set_id" is null and not "booking_events"."had_photos" and "booking_events"."request_token" is null)

booking_events_staff_change_shape.name: booking_events_staff_change_shape
booking_events_staff_change_shape.value: "booking_events"."kind"::text not in ('status-change', 'rescheduled', 'assigned') or ("booking_events"."request_token" is not null and "booking_events"."job_status" is null and "booking_events"."note" is null and "booking_events"."photo_set_id" is null and not "booking_events"."had_photos")

booking_events_reason_only_on_cancel.name: booking_events_reason_only_on_cancel
booking_events_reason_only_on_cancel.value: ("booking_events"."reason" is not null) = coalesce("booking_events"."kind"::text = 'status-change' and "booking_events"."new_status"::text = 'cancelled', false)

booking_events_rescheduled_has_times.name: booking_events_rescheduled_has_times
booking_events_rescheduled_has_times.value: ("booking_events"."kind"::text = 'rescheduled') = ("booking_events"."moved_from" is not null) and ("booking_events"."moved_from" is null) = ("booking_events"."moved_to" is null) and ("booking_events"."moved_from" is null or "booking_events"."moved_from" <> "booking_events"."moved_to")

bookings_pickup_complete.name: bookings_pickup_complete
bookings_pickup_complete.value: ("bookings"."pickup_address" is null) = ("bookings"."pickup_postal_code" is null) and ("bookings"."pickup_address" is null) = ("bookings"."pickup_fee_paise" is null)

estimates_one_current_per_booking.name: estimates_one_current_per_booking
estimates_one_current_per_booking.where: "estimates"."sent_at" is not null and "estimates"."superseded_at" is null

estimates_send_complete.name: estimates_send_complete
estimates_send_complete.value: ("estimates"."sent_at" is null) = ("estimates"."sent_by" is null) and ("estimates"."sent_at" is null) = ("estimates"."send_token" is null)

estimates_superseded_after_send.name: estimates_superseded_after_send
estimates_superseded_after_send.value: "estimates"."superseded_at" is null or "estimates"."sent_at" is not null

opening_hours_closed_or_opens_before_clo.name: opening_hours_closed_or_opens_before_closes
opening_hours_closed_or_opens_before_clo.value: ("opening_hours"."opens" is null and "opening_hours"."closes" is null) or ("opening_hours"."opens" is not null and "opening_hours"."closes" is not null and "opening_hours"."opens" < "opening_hours"."closes")

photos_stored_complete.name: photos_stored_complete
photos_stored_complete.value: "photos"."status" <> 'stored' or ("photos"."bytes" is not null and "photos"."stored_at" is not null)
